verdict.rationale: Airweave ships a CLI, REST API with OpenAPI spec, Python/TS SDKs for source connection creation, self-hosted deploy via git clone + start.sh, and webhooks for event-driven automation, all of which support running headlessly/in scripts or CI. However there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions) or independent corroboration of headless/CI use specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline example/docs, independent hands-on confirmation of headless automation.
